pack.name: 自主規制天狗 / システムエンジニア天狗
pack.notes: Black background removed with border-connected flood fill. Internal black outlines are preserved. Rectangles are measured on the original spritesheet, with lower effect/UI rows re-cut to avoid label bleed and neighboring sprite overlap. Face icons were re-cut on fixed 100x100 canvases from y=840 to remove top/bottom misalignment and neighboring sprite bleed.
